g.text: Configure or repair the environment — wizard (CUC-3)
Run or show the adapter login (no config write)
Offer repair for remaining issues / report
This is the TARGET CUC-3 algorithm. Current build (bounded):

interactive setup wizard (setup, interactive mode) = profile-to-configure choice (defaultProfile never repointed) + validated adapter binary-path capture + per-role lane model selection from the catalog (when a lane's adapter has >=2 entries) + summary + confirm + post-write doctor;
interactive guided repair (doctor fix, interactive mode) = adapter binary-path repair only (non-adapter issues stay guidance-only);
Target/future: SuggestLanes (pre-filter), pre-write live identity probe, reauthenticate/model/swap repairs.
